entries.zh: 剧院外的人群高喊：打倒审查制度！

entries.en: The company announced further downsizing.
entries.zh: 公司宣布进一步缩编。

entries.en: The writer could draw upon years of travel.
entries.zh: 作家可以借鉴多年的旅行经历。

entries.en: The clinic offers a drop-in advice session.
entries.zh: 诊所提供无需预约的咨询时段。

entries.en: The dry cleaner returned the coat on Friday.
entries.zh: 干洗店星期五送还了外套。

entries.en: They dug a shallow trench beside the path.
entries.zh: 他们在小路旁挖了一条浅沟。

entries.en: The leaflet explains e- in e-commerce.
entries.zh: 传单解释了e-commerce中的e-。

entries.en: The note gives several examples, e.g. maps and photographs.
entries.zh: 注释给出了几个例子，例如地图和照片。

entries.en: The lesson explains electro- in electrochemistry.
entries.zh: 这节课解释了electrochemistry中的electro-。

entries.en: The tutor explained em- by discussing empower.
entries.zh: 导师通过讨论empower解释了em-。

entries.en: The sequel is every bit as exciting as the first film.
entries.zh: 续集与第一部电影同样精彩。

entries.en: The article uses ex- to describe her former role.
entries.zh: 文章用ex-表示她过去担任的职务。

entries.en: The glossary explains extra- in extraterrestrial.
entries.zh: 术语表解释了extraterrestrial中的extra-。

entries.en: The historical account says the agreement was reached in extremis.
entries.zh: 历史记述说，协议是在极端危急时达成的。

entries.en: She fed the cats before leaving.
entries.zh: 她离开前喂了猫。

entries.meaningZh: 细齿梳；细致检查的比喻用语
entries.en: She went through the contract with a fine-tooth comb.
entries.zh: 她极其仔细地检查了合同。

entries.en: They booked a fly-drive holiday.
entries.zh: 他们预订了一个飞抵后租车旅游的假期。

entries.en: The talk was followed by a short discussion.
entries.zh: 演讲之后是一场简短讨论。

entries.en: She took a foundation course before the degree.
entries.zh: 她在攻读学位前读了预科课程。

entries.en: The estate plan uses gdn for the garden.
entries.zh: 庄园平面图用gdn代表花园。

entries.en: We need to get on top of the backlog.
entries.zh: 我们需要处理好积压的工作。

entries.en: They agreed to give the documents up to the court.
entries.zh: 他们同意把文件交给法院。

entries.meaningZh: 将要；going to的非正式写法
entries.en: I’m gonna call her tonight.
entries.zh: 我今晚打算给她打电话。

entries.en: I got your message this morning.
entries.zh: 我今天早上收到了你的消息。

entries.en: The historical report examines gun-running in the region.
entries.zh: 历史报告研究了该地区的军火走私。

entries.en: She was upset when he chose to hang up on her.
entries.zh: 他竟然挂断她的电话，让她很难过。

entries.en: The court notice places HIH before the name.
entries.zh: 宫廷通知在名字前加上了帝国殿下称谓缩写HIH。

entries.en: Their approach was hit and miss.
entries.zh: 他们的方法是碰运气的。

entries.en: The announcement came hot on the heels of the merger.
entries.zh: 公告紧接着合并而来。

entries.en: The glossary explains hyper- as indicating excess.
entries.zh: 术语表把hyper-解释为表示过量。

entries.en: The teacher explains im- by comparing possible and impossible.
entries.zh: 老师通过对比possible与impossible解释im-。

entries.en: The dancers moved in sync.
entries.zh: 舞者们同步移动。

entries.en: In the fullness of time, the truth emerged.
entries.zh: 到适当时候，真相显露了。

entries.en: The teacher used inactive to explain the negative prefix in-.
entries.zh: 老师用inactive解释否定前缀in-。

entries.en: The fee is £20 incl. postage.
entries.zh: 费用为二十英镑，包含邮资。

entries.en: They could not keep debating the same point ad infinitum.
entries.zh: 他们不能无休止地争论同一点。

entries.en: The dictionary marks the word int.
entries.zh: 词典把这个词标为感叹词。

entries.en: The term inter-city illustrates the between sense of inter-.
entries.zh: inter-city一词展示了inter-表示在两者之间的含义。

entries.en: The unit prefix kilo- means one thousand.
entries.zh: 单位前缀kilo-表示一千。

entries.meaningZh: 让争执双方冷静下来；迫使双方合作
entries.en: Someone needs to knock their heads together before the dispute ruins the project.
entries.zh: 需要有人让他们冷静合作，免得争执毁掉项目。

entries.en: She led the visitors to the garden.
entries.zh: 她带领访客来到花园。

entries.en: Please left-justify the paragraph.
entries.zh: 请把这一段左对齐。

entries.term: like a fish out of water
entries.meaningZh: 如鱼离水；感到格格不入
entries.en: At the formal dinner, he felt like a fish out of water.
entries.zh: 在正式晚宴上，他感到格格不入。

entries.en: She lit the candle before opening the book.
entries.zh: 她先点亮蜡烛，然后打开书。

entries.en: The account explains how the favourite came to lose the day.
entries.zh: 记述解释了热门选手如何最终失利。

entries.en: The lecturer contrasted macro- with micro-.
entries.zh: 讲师对比了macro-与micro-。

entries.en: Market testing revealed a problem with the packaging.
entries.zh: 市场测试发现了包装方面的问题。

entries.en: The dictionary marks the noun masc.
entries.zh: 词典把这个名词标为阳性。

entries.en: The tutor explains mega- in megawatt.
entries.zh: 导师解释了megawatt中的mega-。

entries.en: Three men were waiting outside the workshop.
entries.zh: 三个男人在车间外等候。

entries.en: The old report uses mic. in the observation column.
entries.zh: 旧报告在观察栏中使用了显微镜下的缩写mic.。

entries.en: The unit prefix micro- represents one millionth.
entries.zh: 单位前缀micro-表示百万分之一。

entries.en: The bowl had a milk white glaze.
entries.zh: 碗上有一层乳白色釉。

entries.en: The teacher used millimetre to illustrate milli-.
entries.zh: 老师用millimetre说明milli-。

entries.en: The brochure explains mini- in minibus.
entries.zh: 宣传册解释了minibus中的mini-。

entries.en: The prefix mis- changes interpret to misinterpret.
entries.zh: 前缀mis-把interpret变成misinterpret。

entries.en: The lesson links mono- with the idea of one.
entries.zh: 这节课把mono-与一的概念联系起来。

entries.en: The brochure uses multilingual to illustrate multi-.
entries.zh: 宣传册用multilingual说明multi-。

entries.en: The medical glossary explains the narco- element.
entries.zh: 医学术语表解释了narco-这一构词成分。

entries.en: There was a noticeable narrowing of the river beyond the bridge.
entries.zh: 过桥后，河道明显变窄了。

entries.meaningZh: 险些相撞的事件；差点发生的碰撞
entries.en: There was a near miss at the crossing when a cyclist failed to stop.
entries.zh: 一名骑车人没有停车，在路口险些发生碰撞。

entries.en: The historian explained neo- in the name of the movement.
entries.zh: 历史学者解释了该运动名称中的neo-。

entries.en: The chemical glossary explains nitro- before giving compound names.
entries.zh: 化学术语表先解释nitro-，再列举化合物名称。

entries.en: No less than fifty people offered to help.
entries.zh: 多达五十人表示愿意帮忙。

entries.en: The visitor was no other than her former teacher.
entries.zh: 来客正是她以前的老师。

entries.en: No wonder you are tired after that journey.
entries.zh: 走了那么一趟，难怪你累了。

entries.en: The prefix non- changes smoker to non-smoker.
entries.zh: 前缀non-把smoker变成non-smoker。

entries.en: The treaty included a non-aggression clause.
entries.zh: 条约包含一项互不侵犯条款。

entries.meaningZh: 完全不是那回事；一点也不（否定回应）
entries.en: We expected queues at the museum. Not a bit of it: we walked straight in.
entries.zh: 我们本以为博物馆会排队。根本不是那样：我们直接就进去了。

entries.en: I am not much of a cook.
entries.zh: 我不太会做饭。

entries.en: “What happened?” “Nothing much.”
entries.zh: “发生了什么？”“没什么。”

entries.meaningZh: 核心家庭；仅由父母和子女组成的家庭
entries.en: Her novel follows a nuclear family of two parents and three children.
entries.zh: 她的小说讲述了一个由父母和三个孩子组成的核心家庭的故事。

entries.meaningZh: 在未被拍摄的情况下；在电视或电影镜头范围之外
entries.en: The interviewer asked her one last question off camera.
entries.zh: 采访者在不拍摄的情况下，问了她最后一个问题。

entries.meaningZh: 禁止进入的；不许进入的
entries.en: The roof terrace was off limits while the railings were being replaced.
entries.zh: 更换栏杆期间，屋顶露台禁止进入。

entries.meaningZh: oft-；经常，常见于复合修饰语
entries.en: The essay repeats an oft-quoted line.
entries.zh: 文章重复了一句常被引用的话。

entries.en: One or other of the keys must fit.
entries.zh: 这两把钥匙总有一把能用。

entries.meaningZh: 开放招待；欢迎所有来客参加的非正式聚会
entries.en: On New Year's Day they held open house for anyone passing through the village.
entries.zh: 元旦那天，他们敞开家门，欢迎所有途经村子的人来作客。

entries.meaningZh: 开源的；源代码可供修改和再发布的（软件）
entries.en: The committee asked whether the new scheduling program was open-source.
entries.zh: 委员会询问新的排班程序是否开源。

entries.en: She decided to opt out of the optional group photograph.
entries.zh: 她决定不参加那次自愿参与拍摄的集体照。

entries.en: Please tell us whether the room is available or otherwise.
entries.zh: 请告诉我们房间是否可用。

entries.en: We could meet at a café or wherever you prefer.
entries.zh: 我们可以在咖啡馆或你喜欢的其他地方见面。

entries.meaningZh: 不应该；ought not的缩略形式
entries.en: You oughtn’t to leave the door unlocked.
entries.zh: 你不应该让门不上锁。

entries.meaningZh: 不经诉讼；以庭外方式解决（纠纷）
entries.en: The neighbours settled the boundary dispute out of court.
entries.zh: 邻居们通过庭外和解解决了边界争议。

entries.en: We were out of time before the final question.
entries.zh: 还没到最后一个问题，我们的时间就用完了。

entries.en: The teacher used outnumber to explain out-.
entries.zh: 老师用outnumber解释out-。

entries.meaningZh: 涉及仿佛意识离开自身躯体的感觉或体验的
entries.en: The memoir describes an out-of-body experience during the operation.
entries.zh: 回忆录描述了手术期间一次仿佛意识离开身体的体验。

entries.meaningZh: 过度拥挤；一处地方容纳过多的人或物的状况
entries.en: Overcrowding made it difficult to move between the tables.
entries.zh: 过度拥挤让人在桌子之间很难走动。

entries.meaningZh: 首要的；压倒其他因素的
entries.en: Her overriding concern was to keep the children together.
entries.zh: 她首要关心的是让孩子们待在一起。

entries.meaningZh: 包装箱；运输或储存货物的大箱子
entries.en: The packing case was too wide to fit through the workshop door.
entries.zh: 那个包装箱太宽，进不了车间的门。

entries.en: The lecture explains pan- in the phrase pan-European.
entries.zh: 讲座解释了pan-European中的pan-。

entries.meaningZh: 维持和平行动；由军队执行的维和活动
entries.en: The debate focused on the costs of peacekeeping after the ceasefire.
entries.zh: 辩论重点讨论了停火之后维持和平行动的费用。

entries.en: Her newly permed hair framed her face.
entries.zh: 她刚烫过的头发衬托着脸庞。

entries.meaningZh: 可得到或挑选的东西；剩余可取之物（复数，非正式）
entries.en: There were slim pickings at the market by the time we arrived.
entries.zh: 我们到达市场时，已经没什么好东西可挑了。

entries.en: The shopping list says one pkt of biscuits.
entries.zh: 购物清单上写着一包饼干。

entries.meaningZh: 整形外科医生；从事组织修复、重建或外形改善手术的医生
entries.en: The plastic surgeon discussed reconstruction options with the patient after the injury.
entries.zh: 受伤后，整形外科医生与患者讨论了重建手术的选择。

entries.meaningZh: 认罪协商；就认罪及减轻指控等事项进行的协商过程
entries.en: The lawyer said plea bargaining might avoid a lengthy trial.
entries.zh: 律师说，认罪协商或许能免去漫长的审判。

entries.meaningZh: 用微沸液体煮食物的烹调方法；小火煮
entries.en: For the pear dessert, she preferred poaching to baking.
entries.zh: 做梨甜点时，她更喜欢用小火煮，而不是烘烤。

entries.meaningZh: 参照点；用于辨别方位或进行比较的基准
entries.en: We used the church tower as a point of reference when comparing the two maps.
entries.zh: 比较两张地图时，我们把教堂钟楼作为参照点。

entries.en: The glossary explains poly- in polygon.
entries.zh: 术语表解释了polygon中的poly-。

entries.en: The term post-war shows the time sense of post-.
entries.zh: post-war一词展示了post-表示之后的含义。

entries.en: The lesson explains pre- in pre-war.
entries.zh: 这节课解释了pre-war中的pre-。

entries.en: The pre-schooler proudly wrote her own name.
entries.zh: 那个学龄前孩子自豪地写出了自己的名字。

entries.meaningZh: 深入探究的；刨根问底的
entries.en: She answered every probing question without looking at her notes.
entries.zh: 她没有查看笔记，就回答了每一个刨根问底的问题。

entries.meaningZh: 苏格兰的地方检察官；负责公诉及某些死亡调查的法律官员
entries.en: The report was passed to the procurator fiscal for consideration.
entries.zh: 报告被转交给苏格兰地方检察官审阅。

entries.en: The organisation became a profit-making company.
entries.zh: 该组织变成了一家营利公司。

entries.en: The glossary explains proto- as first or earliest.
entries.zh: 术语表把proto-解释为第一或最早。

entries.en: The glossary explains psycho- in the technical term.
entries.zh: 术语表解释了该专业术语中的psycho-。

entries.meaningZh: 公共广播系统；在公共场所扩音和传递通知的电子系统
entries.en: We could barely hear the announcement through the station's public address system.
entries.zh: 我们几乎听不清车站公共广播系统里的通知。

entries.en: The lecturer explained the quasi- element in the legal label.
entries.zh: 讲师解释了法律称谓中的quasi-。

entries.meaningZh: 射电望远镜；接收来自天体的射频电磁辐射的天文观测仪器
entries.en: The radio telescope collected signals while the optical observatory was closed.
entries.zh: 光学天文台关闭时，那台射电望远镜在收集信号。

entries.en: They ran to the station.
entries.zh: 他们跑向车站。

entries.meaningZh: 疲于奔命、难以休息的竞争生活或忙碌常规
entries.en: He left the rat race and opened a small repair shop near the coast.
entries.zh: 他退出了那种疲于奔命的竞争生活，在海岸附近开了一家小修理铺。

entries.en: The driver braked sharply to avoid rear-ending the stationary car.
entries.zh: 司机猛踩刹车，以免追尾那辆停着的汽车。

entries.en: A careful recasting of the final paragraph made the argument easier to follow.
entries.zh: 仔细改写最后一段后，论证变得更容易理解。

entries.en: The exercise asks for a reflexive verb.
entries.zh: 练习要求填一个反身动词。

entries.en: The designer explained the backward-looking sense of retro-.
entries.zh: 设计师解释了retro-中回顾过去的含义。

entries.en: Please right-justify the numbers.
entries.zh: 请把数字右对齐。

entries.meaningZh: 不公正的对待或惩罚（英国用语）
entries.en: He called the rushed hearing rough justice because none of the witnesses had been heard.
entries.zh: 他把那场仓促的听证称为不公正的对待，因为没有一位证人得到陈述的机会。

entries.meaningZh: 枪械保险装置；防止意外击发的锁定装置
entries.en: The damaged safety catch was one reason the old rifle was kept out of use.
entries.zh: 损坏的保险装置是那支旧步枪停用的原因之一。

entries.en: The program deletes the scratch file when the task ends.
entries.zh: 任务结束时，程序会删除临时工作文件。

entries.meaningZh: 保安人员；负责守卫和看守的人
entries.en: The security guard found a lost scarf beside the locked entrance.
entries.zh: 保安在锁着的入口旁发现了一条遗失的围巾。

entries.en: The teacher used self-control to explain self-.
entries.zh: 老师用self-control解释self-。

entries.meaningZh: 休耕安排；让部分农田暂不生产以减少农产品过剩等的措施
entries.en: The farmer explained how set-aside had reduced the land planted with wheat.
entries.zh: 农场主解释了休耕安排如何减少了小麦种植面积。

entries.meaningZh: 不断改变位置的；移动的
entries.en: The fishermen watched the shifting sandbanks before choosing where to land.
entries.zh: 渔民们观察了那些不断移动的沙洲，然后才决定在哪里靠岸。

entries.meaningZh: 未事先查看或检验就；未看实物就
entries.en: She refused to rent the cottage sight unseen, even at the lower price.
entries.zh: 即使租金更低，她也不肯没看过就租下那间小屋。

entries.meaningZh: 看见；目击某事物的一次经历
entries.en: A sighting of the rare bird brought several photographers to the marsh.
entries.zh: 有人目击了那只珍稀鸟，于是几位摄影师赶到了沼泽。

entries.en: The dictionary marks the form sing.
entries.zh: 词典把这个形式标为单数。

entries.en: Each blank requires a singular noun.
entries.zh: 每个空格需要填一个单数名词。

entries.meaningZh: 颅盖；头骨上部覆盖脑部的骨性部分（calvaria）
entries.en: The diagram showed the skull cap separately from the facial bones.
entries.zh: 图中将颅盖与面骨分开画出。

entries.en: The history of medicine includes a chapter on sleeping sickness.
entries.zh: 医学史包括一章关于昏睡病的内容。

entries.en: The tutor explains socio- in socioeconomic.
entries.zh: 导师解释了socioeconomic中的socio-。

entries.meaningZh: 软色情；非露骨色情内容
entries.en: The critic distinguishes soft porn from explicit material.
entries.zh: 评论者区分了软色情与露骨内容。

entries.meaningZh: 舞台右侧；演员面向观众时的右侧舞台区域
entries.en: A narrow staircase led from stage right to the dressing rooms.
entries.zh: 一道狭窄的楼梯从舞台右侧通往化妆间。

entries.en: We spent the clear evening star-gazing.
entries.zh: 我们在这个晴朗的夜晚观星。

entries.en: The report’s stats need updating.
entries.zh: 报告的统计数据需要更新。

entries.meaningZh: 钢鼓乐队；演奏钢鼓等打击乐器的乐队
entries.en: A steel band played beside the harbour as the last ferry arrived.
entries.zh: 最后一班渡轮抵达时，一支钢鼓乐队在港边演奏。

entries.en: The word superhuman illustrates super-.
entries.zh: superhuman一词说明了super-。

entries.en: They bought spices in the suq.
entries.zh: 他们在集市买了香料。

entries.en: The tabletop was covered with maps.
entries.zh: 桌面上铺满了地图。

entries.en: For no clear reason, he seemed to take against the new neighbour.
entries.zh: 不知为何，他似乎开始讨厌新邻居。

entries.en: She wore the very same coat the next day.
entries.zh: 第二天她穿着正是同一件外套。

entries.en: “Think nothing of it,” she said when I thanked her.
entries.zh: 我向她道谢时，她说：“别客气。”

entries.en: Three-quarters of the seats were occupied.
entries.zh: 四分之三的座位有人坐了。

entries.en: Du Toit returned the library key before leaving.
entries.zh: 杜托伊特离开前归还了图书馆钥匙。

entries.en: We arrived too late to buy tickets.
entries.zh: 我们到得太迟，买不到票了。

entries.en: The trades unionist spoke about conditions at the factory.
entries.zh: 工会活动者谈到了工厂的工作条件。

entries.meaningZh: 增至三倍或使增至三倍（treble 的现在分词）
entries.en: The factory is trebling its storage space by adding two new warehouses.
entries.zh: 工厂正在通过增建两座仓库，将储物空间扩大到原来的三倍。

entries.en: The lesson uses triangle to explain tri-.
entries.zh: 这节课用triangle解释tri-。

entries.en: He began to tune out during the long speech.
entries.zh: 长篇演讲期间他开始走神。

entries.en: She chose to turn away from the argument.
entries.zh: 她选择不再卷入争论。

entries.en: The tutor explained ultra- in ultra-modern.
entries.zh: 导师解释了ultra-modern中的ultra-。

entries.en: The prefix un- changes fair to unfair.
entries.zh: 前缀un-把fair变成unfair。

entries.en: The silence was unnerving.
entries.zh: 这片寂静令人不安。

entries.en: “Up with the banner!” the organiser called.
entries.zh: “举起横幅！”组织者喊道。

entries.en: The title vice-chair illustrates vice-.
entries.zh: vice-chair这个职称说明了vice-。

entries.en: The paper clearly distinguishes observations made in vitro from observations in living organisms.
entries.zh: 论文清楚区分了体外观察与活体中的观察。

entries.en: She put her name on the waiting list.
entries.zh: 她把名字登记在候补名单上。

entries.en: A water vole disappeared into the riverbank.
entries.zh: 一只水䶄消失在河岸里。

entries.en: The note says delivery takes one wk.
entries.zh: 便条上说送货需要一周。

entries.en: They won the final match by one point.
entries.zh: 他们以一分优势赢得了决赛。

entries.meaningZh: you would或you had的缩略形式
entries.en: You’d enjoy the exhibition.
entries.zh: 你会喜欢这个展览的。

entries.en: You’ll find the spare key in the drawer.
entries.zh: 你会在抽屉里找到备用钥匙。

entries.en: The blacksmith repaired the gate’s broken hinge.
entries.zh: 铁匠修好了大门坏掉的铰链。

entries.en: We finally made headway with the repairs.
entries.zh: 我们的维修终于有了进展。

entries.en: The parcel weighs 5 lb.
entries.zh: 这个包裹重五磅。

entries.en: She did not make the story up.
entries.zh: 她没有编造这个故事。

entries.en: The recipe calls for 4 oz. of butter.
entries.zh: 食谱需要四盎司黄油。

entries.en: Please pick the papers up.
entries.zh: 请把纸捡起来。

entries.en: Put your coat on before going outside.
entries.zh: 出门前穿上外套。

entries.en: The chemical table uses sat. for saturated.
entries.zh: 化学表用sat.表示饱和的。

entries.en: The schoolboy hurried home with his new library book.
entries.zh: 男学童带着新借的图书匆匆回家。

entries.en: She found the timetable on the web.
entries.zh: 她在网上找到了时刻表。

entries.en: Do not throw the receipt away yet.
entries.zh: 先不要把收据扔掉。

entries.en: The parcel was sent from the U.S.
entries.zh: 包裹从美国寄来。

entries.en: He forgot to wind the clock up.
entries.zh: 他忘了给钟上发条。

entries.en: The label says the blanket contains acrylic fiber.
entries.zh: 标签说明毯子含有腈纶。

entries.en: An adjutant stork stood beside the shallow pool.
entries.zh: 一只秃鹳站在浅池旁。

entries.en: The old textbook places the arsenic group in a separate section.
entries.zh: 旧教材把砷组放在单独一节。

entries.meaningZh: 繁重费力的工作（通常连写 backbreaker；本例不是药物俚语）
entries.en: This job is a real backbreaker; every sack has to be carried up two flights of stairs.
entries.zh: 这活真够累人的，每袋东西都得扛上两段楼梯。

entries.en: We met at baggage claim.
entries.zh: 我们在行李提取处见面。

entries.en: The drawing shows a barrier strip between the two sections.
entries.zh: 图纸显示两部分之间有一条隔离带。

entries.en: The specification calls for a bitumastic coating.
entries.zh: 规格说明要求使用沥青胶泥涂层。

entries.en: The garden’s blazing star had begun to flower.
entries.zh: 花园里的蛇鞭菊开始开花了。

entries.en: The bird guide identifies the boatswain bird as a tropicbird.
entries.zh: 鸟类指南把boatswain bird解释为热带鹲的俗名。

entries.en: Bouncing bet grew along the old fence.
entries.zh: 肥皂草沿旧篱笆生长。

entries.en: Butterfly pea climbed over the fence.
entries.zh: 蝶豆攀上了篱笆。

entries.meaningZh: 石灰光；旧舞台照明方式
entries.en: The theatre history explains the use of calcium light.
entries.zh: 剧院史解释了石灰光的使用。

entries.en: Carpet grass covered the open patch.
entries.zh: 地毯草覆盖了那块空地。

entries.meaningZh: 脉络丛动脉；所选脑血管义
entries.en: The brain diagram labels a choroidal artery.
entries.zh: 脑部图标出了一条脉络丛动脉。

entries.en: She baked a coconut cake for the picnic.
entries.zh: 她为野餐烤了一个椰子蛋糕。

entries.en: A collared peccary crossed the forest path.
entries.zh: 一只领西猯穿过林间小路。

entries.en: The computer store repaired her laptop.
entries.zh: 电脑商店修好了她的笔记本电脑。

entries.en: The salad contains crisp cos lettuce.
entries.zh: 沙拉里有脆嫩的罗马生菜。

entries.en: He moved a peg along the cribbage board.
entries.zh: 他沿克里比奇记分板移动了一枚木钉。

entries.en: Crushed rock covered the muddy entrance.
entries.zh: 碎石铺在泥泞的入口处。

entries.en: The customer agent explained the complaint procedure.
entries.zh: 顾客代理人解释了投诉流程。

entries.en: The dental surgery is above the pharmacy.
entries.zh: 牙科诊所在药房楼上。

entries.en: The exhibit contrasts a domesticated animal with its wild relative.
entries.zh: 展览对比了一种驯养动物与其野生近亲。

entries.en: The article explains when double damages may be claimed.
entries.zh: 文章解释了何时可以要求双倍损害赔偿。

entries.en: The crowd cheered his dunk shot.
entries.zh: 人群为他的扣篮欢呼。

entries.meaningZh: 每股收益；标准形式earnings per share
entries.en: The table compares earnings per share across three years.
entries.zh: 表格比较了三年的每股收益。

entries.en: The manual gives dimensions in the English system.
entries.zh: 手册用英制计量系统给出尺寸。

entries.en: The engine diagram labels the exhaust manifold.
entries.zh: 发动机图标出了排气歧管。

entries.en: The old farm building became a workshop.
entries.zh: 旧农用建筑变成了一间车间。

entries.en: The sanitation report discusses the removal of fecal matter.
entries.zh: 卫生报告讨论了粪便清除问题。

entries.en: The museum displays a field glass in its case.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了一只装在盒内的野外望远镜。

entries.en: The furnace drawing marks the firing chamber.
entries.zh: 炉体图标出了燃烧室。

entries.en: The detective suspected an attempt to frame him up.
entries.zh: 侦探怀疑有人企图诬陷他。

entries.en: The fraternity house stood opposite the campus library.
entries.zh: 兄弟会会馆位于校园图书馆对面。

entries.meaningZh: 以标准重力加速度为基准表示的加速度负荷
entries.en: The diagram explains G-force without giving flight instructions.
entries.zh: 图示解释了G力，没有提供飞行操作指示。

entries.en: The zoo’s Gaboon viper was difficult to spot among the leaves.
entries.zh: 动物园里的加蓬蝰在树叶间很难辨认。

entries.en: They played gin rummy after dinner.
entries.zh: 他们晚饭后玩了金拉米牌戏。

entries.en: The shopkeeper promised to give full measure to every customer.
entries.zh: 店主承诺给每位顾客足够的分量。

entries.en: She sprinkled grated cheese over the pasta.
entries.zh: 她把磨碎的奶酪撒在意面上。

entries.en: The museum keeps gum olibanum in a labelled jar.
entries.zh: 博物馆把乳香树脂保存在贴有标签的罐子里。

entries.en: The museum workshop includes a hand blower.
entries.zh: 博物馆工坊中有一台手动鼓风机。

entries.en: She learned to hang glide during the summer.
entries.zh: 她在夏天学会了悬挂式滑翔。

entries.meaningZh: 肝色丽唐纳雀；hepatic tanager所指鸟类
entries.en: A hepatic tanager called from the pine canopy.
entries.zh: 一只肝色丽唐纳雀在松树冠层鸣叫。

entries.en: The strap will hook on to the small ring.
entries.zh: 带子会钩在小环上。

entries.en: The financial article discusses demand for a hot issue.
entries.zh: 财经文章讨论了对一项热门新发行证券的需求。

entries.en: A house wren sang from the fence.
entries.zh: 一只家鹪鹩在篱笆上鸣叫。

entries.en: They arrived in style in a restored vintage car.
entries.zh: 他们乘着修复后的老爷车风风光光地到达。

entries.en: The specification calls for ingot iron rather than cast iron.
entries.zh: 规格说明要求使用锭铁，而不是铸铁。

entries.en: The museum chart shows a jawless fish.
entries.zh: 博物馆图表展示了一种无颌鱼。

entries.en: The workshop inventory includes a jointer.
entries.zh: 车间清单包括一台平刨。

entries.meaningZh: 结势垒；半导体结处的势垒
entries.en: The semiconductor diagram marks the junction barrier.
entries.zh: 半导体图标出了结势垒。

entries.en: The review explains why ketosis-prone diabetes is not a single uniform condition.
entries.zh: 综述解释了为何易发酮症型糖尿病不是一种单一均一的病况。

entries.en: The art lesson explains linear perspective.
entries.zh: 美术课解释了线性透视法。

entries.en: The firm kept enough liquid assets to meet its immediate bills.
entries.zh: 公司保有足够的流动资产以支付近期账单。

entries.en: The spa’s old menu lists lithia water.
entries.zh: 温泉疗养地的旧饮品单列出了含锂矿泉水。

entries.en: The caretaker is required to live in.
entries.zh: 管理员被要求住在工作地点。

entries.en: A Maltese cross was engraved on the button.
entries.zh: 纽扣上刻着马耳他十字图案。

entries.en: The display includes a carved imitation of a mandrake root.
entries.zh: 展品包括一个曼德拉草根的雕刻仿制品。

entries.en: An oak fern spread its fronds beneath the birches.
entries.zh: 一株欧亚羽节蕨在桦树下舒展叶片。

entries.en: She wore an olive brown coat.
entries.zh: 她穿着一件橄榄褐色外套。

entries.en: The specification calls for pit run gravel.
entries.zh: 规格说明要求使用未筛分砾石。

entries.en: The interview with a primordial dwarf focused on accessible transport.
entries.zh: 对一位原始性侏儒症患者的访谈聚焦于无障碍交通。

entries.en: A purging cassia grew beside the garden entrance.
entries.zh: 一棵腊肠树生长在花园入口旁。

entries.en: The band marched across the square in quick time.
entries.zh: 乐队以齐步速度走过广场。

entries.en: The guide groups tuna with other scombroid fish.
entries.zh: 图鉴把金枪鱼与其他鲭形鱼类归在一起。

entries.meaningZh: 片状闪电；标准形式sheet lightning
entries.en: Sheet lightning lit the distant clouds.
entries.zh: 片状闪电照亮了远处的云。

entries.en: The small businessman knew most of his customers.
entries.zh: 这位小企业经营者认识大多数顾客。

entries.en: We finally reached solid ground.
entries.zh: 我们终于到达了坚实的地面。

entries.en: The brain diagram labels a striate vein.
entries.zh: 脑部图标出了一条纹状体静脉。

entries.meaningZh: 鮣鱼；头部有吸盘的海鱼
entries.en: The photograph shows a sucking fish attached to a larger fish.
entries.zh: 照片显示一条鮣鱼附着在一条较大的鱼身上。

entries.meaningZh: 沼泽山核桃；所给植物俗名
entries.en: A swamp hickory stood near the wet ground.
entries.zh: 一棵沼泽山核桃立在湿地附近。

entries.en: The old invoice specifies Swedish iron.
entries.zh: 旧发票注明使用瑞典熟铁。

entries.en: The technician found a fault in the tape transport.
entries.zh: 技术员发现了磁带传送机构的一处故障。

entries.meaningZh: 塔塔酱；一种配鱼食用的调味酱
entries.en: He asked for tartar sauce with the fish.
entries.zh: 他要了塔塔酱配鱼。

entries.meaningZh: 胸腺核酸的旧名称thymic acid
entries.en: The history of chemistry explains thymic acid as an older nucleic-acid name.
entries.zh: 化学史把thymic acid解释为胸腺核酸的旧名称。

entries.en: The museum photograph shows a tiger snake near the reeds.
entries.zh: 博物馆照片显示一条芦苇附近的虎蛇。

entries.en: A toggle switch protruded from the radio’s side.
entries.zh: 收音机侧面伸出一个拨动开关。

entries.en: She packed her toilet articles in a small bag.
entries.zh: 她把洗漱用品装进小袋子里。

entries.en: The old bridge became a tourist attraction.
entries.zh: 旧桥成了旅游景点。

entries.en: A tractor-trailer waited at the loading bay.
entries.zh: 一辆半挂牵引车在装卸区等候。

entries.en: A tree fern shaded the path.
entries.zh: 一株树蕨给小路遮阴。

entries.en: They used a trial-and-error approach to arrange the shelves.
entries.zh: 他们用反复试错的方法摆放架子。

entries.en: The tool museum displays a two-handed saw.
entries.zh: 工具博物馆展出了一把双人拉锯。

entries.en: The field guide includes a photograph of unicorn root in flower.
entries.zh: 野外指南包括一张独角根开花的照片。

entries.en: The laboratory report records a vaginal smear.
entries.zh: 实验室报告记录了一项阴道涂片检查。

entries.meaningZh: 升降速度表；所选航空义
entries.en: The glider pilot checked the variometer.
entries.zh: 滑翔机飞行员查看了升降速度表。

entries.en: The archive collects personal accounts of COVID-19.
entries.zh: 档案收集了关于2019冠状病毒病的个人记述。

entries.en: The hall’s acoustics made every whispered word audible.
entries.zh: 大厅的声学特性让每一句低语都能听见。

entries.meaningZh: 获得某人的好感或认可
entries.en: He was in his aunt’s good books after fixing the gate.
entries.zh: 修好大门后，他赢得了姑妈的好感。

entries.en: He blew his chance by missing the interview.
entries.zh: 他因错过面试而失去了机会。

entries.en: A ringing phone broke the spell.
entries.zh: 电话铃打破了令人入迷的气氛。

entries.en: She changed her tune when she saw the full cost.
entries.zh: 她看到全部费用后改了口。

entries.en: The cost of the mistake finally came home to him.
entries.zh: 他终于深切意识到了错误的代价。

entries.en: He found it difficult to confide in his brother.
entries.zh: 他发现很难向兄弟倾诉。

entries.en: It dawned on me that I had the wrong address.
entries.zh: 我开始明白自己拿错了地址。

entries.en: By hiding the problem, you may do her a disservice.
entries.zh: 隐瞒问题可能反而对她不利。

entries.en: I feel like taking a walk.
entries.zh: 我想散散步。

entries.en: It was unfair of them to gang up on the newest member.
entries.zh: 他们联合起来对付最新成员，这不公平。

entries.en: His dismissive tone got her back up.
entries.zh: 他轻蔑的语气惹恼了她。

entries.meaningZh: 受到某人的批评或取笑
entries.en: He got stick from his friends for forgetting the tickets.
entries.zh: 他因忘记带票遭到朋友们的取笑。

entries.meaningZh: 泄露某人的秘密；暴露某人
entries.en: His accent gave him away.
entries.zh: 他的口音暴露了他。

entries.meaningZh: 增加某事的分量或说服力
entries.en: The new evidence gives weight to her explanation.
entries.zh: 新证据使她的解释更有说服力。

entries.term: go out of one's way to do something
entries.en: She went out of her way to help the new student.
entries.zh: 她特意费心帮助新学生。

entries.en: The possibility of losing the house hung over them all winter.
entries.zh: 整个冬天，可能失去房子的阴影一直笼罩着他们。

entries.term: have a keen eye for something
entries.en: He has a keen eye for small details.
entries.zh: 他善于发现细节。

entries.en: You need to have your wits about you in this busy market.
entries.zh: 在这个繁忙市场里，你需要保持机警。

entries.en: I have reservations about the new timetable.
entries.zh: 我对新时刻表有所保留。

entries.en: I thought he was having me on until I saw the letter.
entries.zh: 看到那封信之前，我以为他在拿我开玩笑。

entries.meaningZh: 因某事责怪或记恨某人
entries.en: Please do not hold the delay against her.
entries.zh: 请不要因这次延误而责怪她。

entries.en: The new schedule impinges on her family time.
entries.zh: 新日程影响了她与家人相处的时间。

entries.en: Her friends kept her afloat during the difficult month.
entries.zh: 在那艰难的一个月里，朋友们帮助她撑了下去。

entries.en: The organisers tried to keep the rival groups apart.
entries.zh: 组织者试图让对立的两组人保持分开。

entries.en: The unexpected question knocked him off balance.
entries.zh: 意外的问题让他措手不及。

entries.meaningZh: 在困难时丢下某人不管
entries.en: He left us in the lurch by cancelling at the last minute.
entries.zh: 他临时取消，把我们撇在困难之中。

entries.en: We had to make do with two chairs.
entries.zh: 我们只好将就着用两把椅子。

entries.en: I do not have the faintest idea where the key is.
entries.zh: 我一点也不知道钥匙在哪里。

entries.en: Are you pulling my leg?
entries.zh: 你是在开我玩笑吗？

entries.en: She never puts on airs despite her success.
entries.zh: 尽管很成功，她从不摆架子。

entries.en: She could not put her finger on the cause.
entries.zh: 她无法准确指出原因。

entries.meaningZh: 使自己接受不愿面对的事实
entries.en: He slowly reconciled himself to the delay.
entries.zh: 他慢慢接受了延误这一事实。

entries.en: Please spell the instructions out for the new volunteers.
entries.zh: 请把指示给新志愿者详细讲清楚。

entries.en: She stared daggers at the man who had spoiled the ending.
entries.zh: 她狠狠瞪着那个剧透结局的男人。

entries.en: He took his younger sister into his confidence.
entries.zh: 他把私事告诉了妹妹。

entries.en: I needed a moment to take the news in.
entries.zh: 我需要一点时间来消化这个消息。

entries.en: The children took to their heels when the rain began.
entries.zh: 雨一下，孩子们就拔腿跑了。

entries.en: We should think the plan through before spending any money.
entries.zh: 我们应该在花钱之前把计划仔细想清楚。

entries.meaningZh: 不断牵动某事；反复拉扯
entries.en: The familiar melody tugged away at his memory.
entries.zh: 熟悉的旋律不断牵动着他的记忆。

entries.en: He went outside to walk his frustration off.
entries.zh: 他出去走走，缓解心中的沮丧。

entries.en: She weighed the stranger up before answering.
entries.zh: 她先打量了陌生人，才作答。
